calculators.title_en: Netherlands Freelancer (ZZP) Net Income & Income Tax Calculator
calculators.description_native: Bereken je netto-inkomen als ZZP'er in Nederland inclusief ondernemersaftrek (zelfstandogenaaftrek & startersaftrek), MKB-winstvrijstelling, heffingskortingen en Zvw-premie.

inputs.name: startersaftrek
inputs.label_native: Recht op startersaftrek (max. 3 keer in eerste 5 jaar)?

calculators.formula_explanation: Gross Business Profit = Annual Revenue - Business Expenses. Entrepreneur Deductions (Ondernemersaftrek): If Hours Criterion (1,225 hours/year) is met, deduct Zelfstandogenaaftrek (€2,470 in recent reform trajectory) and Startersaftrek (€2,123 extra for eligible starters). Taxable Profit after Deductions = Gross Profit - Entrepreneur Deductions. MKB-winstvrijstelling (12.7% reduction) is subtracted from Taxable Profit. Personal Taxable Base = Profit after MKB exemption - Pension annuity deduction. Box 1 Income Tax applies progressive tax rates: Bracket 1 (~36.97% up to ~€75,518) and Bracket 2 (~49.50% on excess). Tax credits applied: Algemene Heffingskorting (max ~€3,362, phased out with higher income) and Arbeidskorting (max ~€5,532, phased out with higher profit). Health Insurance Act Contribution (Zvw - Zorgverzekeringswet) for self-employed is calculated at ~5.32% up to max annual income cap (~€71,628). Net Annual Income = Profit - Box 1 Income Tax - Zvw Contribution + Tax Credits.

calculators.title_en: Netherlands Gross to Net Salary & 30% Expat Ruling Calculator
calculators.description_native: Bereken je netto maandsalaris in Nederland op basis van je brutoloon, vakantiegeld (8%), 30%-regeling voor expats, pensioenpremie en heffingskortingen.

inputs.name: lease_car_bijtelling
inputs.label_native: Bruto bijtelling auto van de zaak per maand (€)

calculators.formula_explanation: Gross Annual Base Salary = Monthly Gross * 12 (plus 8% holiday allowance if applicable). 30% Expat Ruling: If active, 30% (or stepped-down 20%/10%) of eligible gross income is paid as tax-free reimbursement (capped at Balkenende norm ~€233,000 max), leaving 70% taxable. Taxable Base = Taxable Gross - Employee Pension Contribution + Company Car Bijtelling. Payroll Tax (Loonheffing) is computed using Box 1 progressive brackets (~36.97% up to ~€75,518; 49.50% on excess). Tax credits applied: Algemene Heffingskorting and Arbeidskorting based on government payroll tables. Net Monthly Salary = Gross Base - Employee Pension - Net Loonheffing (after tax credits) - Car Bijtelling Net Deduction.

calculators.title_en: Netherlands Property Transfer Tax & Buyer Costs Calculator
calculators.description_native: Bereken de overdrachtsbelasting, notariskosten, taxatie- en hypotheekadvieskosten (kosten koper) bij het kopen van een woning in Nederland.
calculators.formula_explanation: Property Transfer Tax (Overdrachtsbelasting): 0% Startersvrijstelling applies if buyer is aged 18-34, purchasing primary home, property price is <= Startersvrijstelling limit (~€510,000 - €525,000 threshold), and hasn't used exemption before. Standard owner-occupier rate (age 35+ or price above limit) is 2%. Investment property / second home / buy-to-let rate is 10.4%. Notary fees (leveringsakte & hypotheekakte) average ~€1,200 - €2,000. Certified valuation report (Taxatierapport) ~€650 - €850. Mortgage advice & mediation fees ~€1,500 - €3,000. Cadastral registry fees (Kadaster) ~€100 - €200. NHG Fee (Borgprovisie): 0.6% of total mortgage amount if mortgage <= NHG cap (~€435,000 limit). Total Buyer Costs (Kosten Koper / k.k.) = Transfer Tax + Notary + Valuation + Mortgage Fee + Cadastral + NHG Fee.

search_terms_native: ontslagvergoeding berekenen wet werk en zekerheid
calculators.description_native: Bereken je wettelijke transitievergoeding bij ontslag in Nederland op basis van je dienstjaren, bruto maandsalaris, vakantiegeld en vaste toeslagen.
calculators.formula_explanation: Gross Monthly Base for Compensation = Gross Monthly Salary + (Gross Monthly Salary * Holiday Allowance %) + (Annual Fixed Bonuses / 12). Statutory Formula: 1/3 of Gross Monthly Base per full year of employment. Fractional years calculated pro-rata: (Gross Monthly Base / 3) * (Remaining Months / 12) + (Gross Monthly Base / 3) * (Remaining Days / 365). Statutory Maximum Cap: Maximum payout is capped at ~€94,000 - €99,000 (indexed annually) or 1 year's gross salary if annual salary exceeds the cap threshold. Net Severance: Severance is taxed in Box 1 under the green tax table rate (groene tabel) without labour tax credits.

calculators.title_native: Bijtelling Auto van de Zaak Calculator
calculators.title_en: Netherlands Company Car Tax Addition (Bijtelling) Calculator
calculators.description_native: Bereken de bruto en netto fiscale bijtelling per maand voor je auto van de zaak (elektrisch, hybride, benzine, diesel of youngtimer) in Nederland.

inputs.name: catalog_price
inputs.label_native: Fiscale cataloguswaarde incl. opties en BTW (€)

inputs.name: registration_year
inputs.label_native: Jaar van eerste toelating op kenteken

inputs.name: private_km_exemption
inputs.label_native: Rijd je meer dan 500 km privé per jaar?
options: Ja (Meer dan 500 km - Bijtelling van toepassing)
Nee (Maximaal 500 km met rittenregistratie - Geen bijtelling)

calculators.formula_explanation: 500 km Exemption: If private usage is <= 500 km per calendar year with a valid trip log (rittenregistratie), Bijtelling rate is 0%. Standard ICE (Petrol/Diesel/Hybrid): 22% of official catalog price per year. Electric Vehicles (EV): Reduced rate applies up to cap (e.g. 16%/17% up to €30,000 cap; 22% on excess above cap; phasing towards standard 22%). Youngtimers (vehicles 15+ years old): 35% bijtelling applied to current fair market value (dagwaarde) instead of original catalog price. Gross Annual Bijtelling = Taxable Value Base * Applicable Bijtelling Rate. Net Monthly Cost = (Gross Annual Bijtelling * Top Income Tax Bracket Rate) / 12.
